messages.血餐を消耗して「血染めの鋏の刃」を育て、「裁縫対象」を付けた敵を出血で切り刻むラ: La Manchaland's barber spends Bloodfeast to develop Blood-tinged Scissorblades, then cuts up enemies marked as Sewing Target through Bleed.
messages.血染めの鋏の刃: S1「裁縫」・S2「カットオフ」が使用時に血餐を消耗して得る。: **Blood-tinged Scissorblades**: Gained when S1 Sewing and S2 Scission spend Bloodfeast on use. The stage rises at 10 and 20: at Ⅱ she gains Offense Level Up and Defense Level Down, and at Ⅲ Offense Level Up. **If she cannot spend Bloodfeast, S1 increases her own Bleed Count, and S2 gives her 5 Bleed.**
messages.裁縫対象: S2のⅢコインで次のターンに付与(低い同期化段階では鋏の刃10以上が: **Sewing Target**: Inflicted next turn by Coin Ⅲ of S2 (requires 10 or more Scissorblades at lower Uptie). The bearer takes more damage based on its Bleed, and S1 and S2 inflict extra Bleed and Bleed Count on Sewing Targets.
messages.S3「新しいドレスをこしらえてやろう！」: 鋏の刃が10以上なら攻撃加重値+1(: **S3 — I'll Make You a New Dress!**: +1 Attack Weight at 10 or more Scissorblades (+2 at 20 or more), and Coin Ⅳ's damage rises with Scissorblades. After the attack, spends 15/10 Scissorblades per Attack Weight gained. Defeating an enemy grants +10/20 Bloodfeast and restores half of the Scissorblades spent (once per turn; +20 more Bloodfeast and +5 Scissorblades against a Sewing Target).
messages.吸血: 各攻撃スキル(S1〜S3)は的中時に与ダメージの一部だけ体力を回復する。: **Lifesteal**: Each attack skill (S1–S3) heals part of the damage dealt as HP on hit.
messages.出血を付与する味方と組んで血餐を貯め、S1・S2で鋏の刃を10・20まで育てる。: Pair her with allies who inflict Bleed to build Bloodfeast, and grow Scissorblades to 10 and 20 with S1 and S2. Cut up enemies marked as Sewing Target by S2 with S3.
